description: Full public profile of one agency: description, industries, team size, client focus, founded year, address, phone, social links, logo, review summary, and links to request a proposal or claim the listing. Takes the slug from search_agencies.

slug.description: Agency slug, e.g. "webfx". A full profile URL also works.

name: get_agency

address.description: City-level address as shown on the profile.

award.description: Directory award, e.g. "Top 10 in London 2026"; null if none.

claimed.description: Whether the listing has been claimed by the agency.

credentials.description: Partner badges and certifications shown on the profile.

freelancer.description: Independent freelancer rather than an agency.

min_monthly_budget.description: Stated minimum monthly budget band, e.g. "$1,000–$2,500/mo"; null when not stated.

phone.description: Business phone, only if shown on the profile.

platforms.description: Platforms the agency says it works on (instagram, tiktok, facebook, linkedin, youtube, pinterest, x, threads, snapchat).

profile_url.description: Canonical profile page. Link to it when you show this agency.

rating.description: Average review rating 1-5; null when there are no reviews.

request_proposal_url.description: Send this link to a business that wants a proposal from this agency.

services.description: Service categories and tags shown on the profile.

slug.description: Agency id; use it with get_agency.

verified.description: Shows the Verified badge on the directory.

title: Get agency profile
